quest.title: Finches Are Still the Cutest!
quest.description: Somewhere in Fontaine's Romaritime Harbor, you and Paimon run into a cheerful researcher-merchant who invites you to play a game...

dialogues.speaker: Basima the Fifth
dialogues.text: Passing Travelers, I, Basima the Fifth, Amurta researcher, rising mercantile star of the Grand Bazaar and Romaritime Harbor alike, beseech thee not to leave too hastily...

dialogues.speaker: Basima the Fifth
dialogues.text: Please. Relax thy body, clear thy mind, and listen closely, for I have a matter of utmost importance to share with you—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, sure they are... But Miss Basima, you say you're a researcher... and a merchant, right? You should know saying something like that without any qualifications can lead to serious arguments!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Researchers are super cautious with their words, and merchants generally don't exaggerate too much, either... At least, that was Paimon's impression...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you go around saying, "My theory is the best" or "My product is the greatest," isn't that just asking for anyone who doesn't buy it to do their best to discredit you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hang on, Paimon's getting a sense of déjà vu. It feels like we've had this conversation before...

choices.text: Well, then I've got something to add to that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if it's not a joke, you shouldn't be so loud...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Of course I know that! There are no absolute "bests" in this world. Any academic theory can be overturned, and all products can be surpassed by new ones.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: But no matter how the objective world changes, everyone has... people and things that they prize most highly — that they will hold most dear no matter what others say.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Those who are afraid of disapproval and who lose confidence in themselves will never become their best selves, and they'll never find someone who truly sees them!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Once you've tried my tabletop game "Bing-Bang Finchball", I'm sure you wouldn't hesitate to shout out "Finches are the cutest!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bing-bang... Finchball? You mean those things on the table beside you? Seems kinda familiar, somehow...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: That's right, once you've played, you'll see for yourself just how adorable finches are!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: I'm currently promoting this tabletop game. Those who get high enough scores can even win rewards!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, y'know what, Paimon finds Finches adorable too, so rewards aren't her top priority. The game just needs to be fun!

choices.text: I'd like to give it a go, too!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: It seems we're on the same page — in which case, I hope you enjoy your experience to the fullest!

choices.text: Let's see just how cute finches really are!
